results.title: Gemini lets you keep chat history and turn off AI training: new settings explained
results.description: In an announcement dated November 16, 2026, the company said Gemini users will be able to keep their chat history while opting out of having those chats used to train generative AI models, a combination the app's single activity switch did not allow.

results.title: Gemini splits saved chats from AI-training controls — Yowox
results.description: Google’s stated two-month window applies to temporary chats and conversations made with chat history turned off; it is not described as a new retention period for every conversation. The report says Google’s updated Privacy Hub states that temporary conversations are not used to train AI models. Because this is a policy rollout rather than proof that every account has changed, users should check the live Gemini controls and current policy before making decisions about particular conversations.
